sprint.name: Sprint 14
sprint.goal: Delivery receipts carry a price, and no message is ever dropped silently.

tickets.title: Fix typo in message-not-found error
tickets.source: A customer support case, passed on by the product manager
tickets.description: A customer reported that the error for an unknown message ID reads "Mesage not found". It should read "Message not found".
acceptance: The error text reads "Message not found".
The change is reviewed by a teammate.
The change is live in production.

history.text: Filed from a customer support case.
Added to Sprint 14 as a starter ticket for the new intern.

tickets.title: Alarm when delivery takes longer than 5 seconds
tickets.source: Action item from last month's incident review
tickets.description: During the last incident we learned about slow deliveries from a customer, not from our own alarms. Add an alarm that pages on-call when delivery latency stays above 5 seconds.
acceptance: The alarm fires in the test environment.
The on-call runbook explains what to do when it fires.

history.text: Picked this up at sprint planning.

tickets.title: Runbook: what to do when the dead-letter queue fills up
tickets.source: On-call notes: this page woke someone twice last month
tickets.description: Whoever is on call at 3 AM should not have to work this out from scratch. Write down the steps: how to check what is stuck, how to replay it safely, and when to escalate.
acceptance: A teammate who has never seen the problem can follow the runbook.

history.text: Picked this up at sprint planning.

tickets.title: Make delivery-worker retry settings configurable
tickets.description: Retry counts and delays are fixed numbers inside the worker. Move them to settings so on-call can tune them without a deployment.
acceptance: Retry count and delay come from settings.
Defaults match today's behavior.

history.text: Picked this up at sprint planning.

tickets.title: Clean up naming in the batch helper
tickets.source: Tech debt noticed during a code review
tickets.description: 'msgs' sits next to 'msg_ids' and people keep mixing them up. Rename it and cover the empty-list case with a test.
acceptance: No behavior change.
Tests cover an empty list.

history.text: Filed and picked up. Small enough to do between bigger things.

tickets.title: Attach the price to each delivery receipt
tickets.source: Product roadmap: Billing integration, this sprint's main goal
tickets.description: Customers want to see what each message cost. Before delivery, ask the Billing service for the per-message price and store it on the receipt.
acceptance: Every receipt carries a price.
A slow or failing Billing service never blocks delivery.

history.text: Broke the feature into smaller tickets and took the first one.

tickets.title: Console: page through a customer's queued messages
tickets.description: The console shows only the first 20 queued messages. The Console team needs a helper that returns one page at a time.
acceptance: Every message appears on exactly one page.
Includes a test.

history.text: Took this at sprint planning. Starting after QS-96.

tickets.title: Deliveries are dropped when the receiver is briefly down
tickets.source: Ticket from the Notifications team, who lost messages last week
tickets.description: When a receiver is down for a few seconds we give up on the message. The Notifications team lost password-reset emails this way.
acceptance: A short outage at the receiver loses no messages.
We do not make the outage worse by hammering the receiver.

history.text: Came in through the team queue. Raised to high priority: customers lost messages.
Pulled into the sprint. I know this code best.

tickets.title: Flaky integration test: test_batch_delivery fails every third run
tickets.source: Noticed by the team: it keeps blocking the Beta stage
tickets.description: The test passes when you retry it. Everyone retries it. Nobody has looked at why.
acceptance: The test passes 50 times in a row.

tickets.title: Dashboard for dead-letter queue depth
tickets.description: We can only see how many messages are stuck by running a query by hand. Put it on the team dashboard.
acceptance: The team dashboard shows stuck messages per customer.

tickets.title: Support message bodies up to 1 MB
tickets.source: Customer request, collected by the product manager
tickets.description: Today the limit is 256 KB. Three large customers have asked for more. Needs a design discussion before anyone starts.
acceptance: A short design document is reviewed by the team first.

tickets.title: Upgrade the Python runtime before it loses support
tickets.source: Company-wide campaign: every team gets this ticket
tickets.description: Our runtime version stops receiving security fixes next quarter. Every service in the company has to move.
acceptance: All Queue Service hosts run the supported version.
